    • place

      public static boolean place(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, net.minecraftforge.fluids.capability.IFluidHandlerItem source, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.ProtectionContext context, net.minecraftforge.fluids.FluidStack stored, boolean allowFaceOffset)
      Places exactly one bucket-volume through Forge's fluid type and placement helper, under FluidTransactions.placeFluidChecked(Level, ProtectionContext, BlockPos, Direction, Fluid, BooleanSupplier) unless it vaporizes, then drains it from the bucket. The helper places from a scratch tank holding that unit, so the bucket is untouched until the placement stands; the item handler determines whether the drain is finite or infinite.
      Parameters:
      stack - the bucket stack driving the placement
      source - item fluid handler drained for the placed unit
      context - authorization identity
      stored - the bucket's current fluid, at least one bucket volume; exactly one is placed
      allowFaceOffset - whether an unusable clicked position may resolve to the neighbor
      Returns:
      true for an accepted client prediction or a completed server placement; false leaves the world unchanged
